title: Monotone calibration production report v1
description: Canonical machine state for one complete production calibration report bundle.

artifacts.$comment: Both mandatory calibration panels exist even when a typed failure prevents drawing a fitted line. Path uniqueness and lexicographic order are cross-entry invariants enforced by the production verifier.

input.$comment: The verifier enforces n_input = n_used + n_excluded and exclusion cardinality/row identity reconciliation.

bootstrap_stability.$comment: The verifier reconciles defined + undefined = requested and lower <= upper when available.

clear_uplift.$comment: The semantic verifier additionally checks the exact frozen gate inventory, operator/threshold evaluation, paired metric equations, positive-repetition share >=0.90, and repetition p10 >=0.

clear_split_sensitivity.$comment: The semantic verifier requires effects length to equal validation.repetitions and recomputes the positive share and p10 from the frozen ledger.

clear_bootstrap_stability.$comment: The semantic verifier enforces defined_resamples + undefined_resamples == 200, lower <= upper, and recomputes both endpoints from the retained resamples.

two_segments.$comment: Two constant branches are a collapsed P1, never a P2 report. The verifier enforces shared boundary, exact count reconciliation, shares summing to one, continuity at c, and collapse of other functionally indistinguishable branches.

llm_advisor.$comment: The verifier additionally enforces calls_accepted+calls_fallback=calls_requested and no secret/raw URL fields.
